thread:
tara nguyen: flagged a follow-up from the arch sync: we still need a clear default for the continuous batcher. do we ship "express defaults" (low wait, small batches) or "dense defaults" (longer coalesce, high batch density)?
dinesh patel: i vote dense by default. most tenants are cost-sensitive and we9ve seen kv-cache thrash with too many tiny batches.
viktor petrov: +1 for route-level override. default dense, allow express per-route. express helped demo apps but hurt some long-context production models.
tara nguyen: real tradeoffs observed in prod: express lowers p95 on light payloads but raises kv_miss and total gpu_seconds by ~20% on mixed traffic. dense reduces unit cost but can add 50-70ms tail on interactive routes.
dinesh patel: propose a tiny surface: latency_target_ms + budget_tokens_per_min. runtime maps those to admission heuristics. example mapping in our prototype:
```
route.latency_target_ms = 120
route.budget_tokens_per_min = 500
```
if latency_target_ms <= 150 -> speculative path enabled (bounded by budget). else dense path.
sre-bot: NOTE: batcher.kv_miss_rate spike detected on canary-7: +9% in last 5m
viktor petrov: that spike matches when express=true was rolled to canary. confirms simulation.
dinesh patel: important ops question: how do we auto-recover if express causes harm? we should auto-disable express for a route if kv_miss_rate delta > 10% for 10m OR tokens_per_gpu > threshold. also surface an override in Console.
tara nguyen: agree. also want a soft_min_batch + hysteresis instead of hard min to avoid thrashing. proposal: soft_min=4, soft_window_ms=20, decay_ms=200.
viktor petrov: telemetry needs: batch_size_histogram, per-route kv_hit_ratio, wait_time_ms_p95, speculative_tokens_used, gpu_seconds_per_token. these are cheap and actionable.
dinesh patel: ops runbook: if auto-disable flips frequently, check for request-size churn or misrouted traffic. suggest simulator replay to reproduce worst-case.
tara nguyen: volunteers: i'll write RFC draft; dinesh will add mapping table and canary rollout plan; viktor will run kv-cache sims and dashboard mock. timeline: RFC by Fri EOD, Monday decision.
dinesh patel: will also add a small CLI to flip forced-mode on a route for debugging.
viktor petrov: i'll paste sim numbers when ready. closing until RFC posted. :thumbsup:
